Samir Patel: Heads up — launching SI Acceleration Kit next Tue. Need alignment: marketplace listing, HW testbench, cert exam.
Maria Chen: 👍 Can we lock the cert exam format? multiple choice + one hands-on lab? timeline?
Jamie Lopez: Suggest 20 q MCQ, 1 timed lab (45m) using the Redwood sandbox on dedicated capacity. Need proctoring plan.
Elliot Brooks: HW partner wants a test image and checklist. @InfraBot can we get a hardware testbench AMI by Friday?
InfraBot: deploy request queued: create-testbench-image. ETA: 48h. /deploy status: pending
Maria Chen: Also need docs/videos for trainer enablement. @Jamie can you record a 15m walkthrough?
Jamie Lopez: I can do Wed afternoon. Will share raw clips to drive folder: https://redwood.app/drive/si-accel-kit
Samir Patel: Marketplace listing - legal OK with co-branding? @Elliot to confirm partner logo usage.
Elliot Brooks: Partner confirmed logo + one joint blurb. They want embargo until 10/14.
Maria Chen: Make sure certification cert IDs map to partner registry. We'll issue badges via Accredify. @Jamie add field in cert CSV: partner_id
Jamie Lopez: Noted. Also want a self-serve lab reservation flow. Frontend work needed — tagging it: FE-6543
Samir Patel: Action items: FE ticket, infra image, exam draft, trainer video, marketplace draft. Who owns exam draft?
Maria Chen: I'll own exam draft. Need SMEs from ML infra — @Elliot can you nominate 2?
Elliot Brooks: Nominating @Ava Kim and @Noah Reed. They'll review and do Q/A by Monday.
Samir Patel: :calendar: Can we do a dry run of full flow next Tue 10 AM PT? If yes, I'll invite partners.
Maria Chen: Works for me.
Jamie Lopez: Works for me.
InfraBot: update: deploy request started. testbench image build logs: https://redwood.app/builds/7890
Samir Patel: Great. I'll prep the marketplace copy. Draft will be in shared doc: https://redwood.app/docs/si-accel-marketplace
Elliot Brooks: Reminder: embargo date -> no external comms until partner sign-off. Add checklist item: 'embargo-ok' in release notes.
Samir Patel: Got it. I'll circulate final checklist by EOD Fri.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — looping in @Product Ops after dry run.
